errors.text_span: а най-ниският е за „Не ми е известно / Нямам инф…“ със стойност 10
errors.evidence: The description correctly states that the category "Не ми е известно / Нямам инф..." has a value of 10, which is the lowest numerical value. However, it incorrectly identifies this as the lowest bar. The visually lowest bar in the chart corresponds to the red bar for the category "Дизайнът е това, което се случ...", which has a value of 13. The bar for the category with value 10 is the last one on the right, and it is visibly taller than the red bar (value 13).
